rows.behavior: kmctl handoffs lists live handoffs newest first by generated.at, ties broken by file name.
rows.fails_when: the order differs from generated.at descending, or a tie is not ordered by file name

rows.behavior: Handoffs past stale_after are left out; one with no stale_after is listed as live; index.md is never listed.
rows.fails_when: an expired handoff is listed, a handoff without stale_after is left out, or index.md appears

rows.behavior: --json prints each entry with id, path, title, description and date, and [] when there is no handoffs folder.
rows.fails_when: an entry lacks any of the five keys, or the empty case is not []

rows.behavior: Without .okf/handoffs/ the text output says there are none and exits 0.
rows.fails_when: the command exits nonzero or prints nothing
